neighbours.label: the word-final spelling pieces -urge / -udge / -erge / -orge (Gorge, splurge, purge, surge, nudge, grudge, fudge, merge, forge, Jorge, George); a spelling unit, not a meaning. Weaker on -idge/-adge/-odge/-edge (bridge, badge, dodge, hedge), near zero on -arge (large, charge), on the whole-word token ' judge', and when the word continues past the ending (Georgia, gorgeous, emerging)
fire: We hiked to the bottom of the Rakaia Gorge.
After payday she likes to splurge on shoes.
The two rivers merge just north of town.
Give the door a nudge and it will open.
My uncle still holds a grudge about it.
They plan to purge the old customer files.
Jorge drove the van to the coast.
The shop sells homemade fudge at the fair.
quiet: We hiked to the bottom of the Rakaia valley.
After payday she likes to charge her card.
The two rivers meet at the edge of town.
Give the door a wedge and it will stay open.
My uncle still wears a badge about it.

neighbours.notes: Step-out feeder of the 'George' neuron bonsai1/L3/N4822+ (largest drop 0.12 in play step). It reads the '-orge' piece that George shares with gorge and Jorge, alongside other -urge/-udge/-erge endings. Twitch chat was quiet this mission; sentences are the streamer's own.

predictions: 8/8 fire; badge is the riskiest near miss (~0.29 in exploration), the rest under 0.2
